correctness.rationale: The finite-chain specialization of the published classification gives a unique inner factor I+tE_1n and a unique central map determined by the diagonal. The quotient-diagonal action is I+1 alpha^T, so the matrix determinant lemma gives the exact regularity condition r(alpha) nonzero. Direct composition gives alpha*beta=alpha+r(alpha)beta, from which the semidirect product follows. The packaged checker verifies the group law and Hom-Jacobi identity in finite cases.

value.rationale: The source leaves regular Hom-Lie structures as a classified normal subgroup with several interacting factors. For the fundamental chain family, the accepted theorem turns that description into a familiar affine semidirect-product group, giving exact finite-field sizes and a sharp q=2 abelian/nonabelian boundary. This makes the classification usable for finite-field enumeration and group-theoretic comparison.
